page.overview:
Who is Folke?

Folke was a retainer of Jarl Ekerot sometime during the .

At some point, the witcher Geralt of Rivia returned with Ekerot to the jarl's dungeons to be shown his prisoner, one of Colm Coimeádaí's men, who was being tortured by Folke for information. As the guard kept hitting him, Geralt stood in and stated he wouldn't break to this type of interrogation and so Ekerot and Folke left the two to talk.
